<entry id="G00469">
<head-word>זֵכֶר, </head-word>
<head-word>זֶכֶר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> זָכַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>memorial, remembrance, symbol, mnemonical allusion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. III, 12 ז' למקדש as a reminiscence of the Temple usages; Pes. 115
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 116
<sup>a</sup> ז' לתפוח typical of the apple tree (Cant. VIII, 5; v. Sot. 11
<sup>b</sup>); ז' לטיט typical of the clay (which the Israelites had to tread). Ber. 2
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 4, a. e. אע"פ שאין … ז' לדבר although there is no proof for it (in the Bible), there is a mnemonical allusion to it; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00470">
<head-word>זִכָּרוֹן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) same, 
<italic>memory, memorial</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 31
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. זִכְרוֹנוֹ לברכה (abbr. ז"ל) of blessed memory, v. זָכַר. Y. Shek. II, 47
<sup>a</sup> top דבריהן הן זִכְרוֹנָן their words are their monument; Gen. R. s. 82 זִכְרוֹנֵיהֶם (pl.). R. Hash. 27
<sup>a</sup> ז' ליום ראשון typical of the first day of creation; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>a Biblical verse in which Divine remembrance is alluded to, citation of verses</italic> &c. R. Hash. IV, 6 ז' … של פורענות citation of remembrance … for evil. Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> ז' של יחיד a verse treating of the remembrance by the Lord of an individual; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זִכְרוֹנוֹת</plural-form>. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup> ספר הז' the Divine records; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>Zikhronoth, that portion of the Musaf of the New Year’s Day which treats of Divine remembrance</italic>. R. Hash. IV, 5, sq.; a. fr.—Constr. זִכְרוֹנֵי, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00471">
<head-word>זַכְרוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of זָכָר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>male genitals; male sex</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Num. R. s. 20, end.—Ab. Zar. 44
<sup>a</sup> (expl. מפלצת, II Chr. XV, 16) כמין ז' a phallus. Men. 6
<sup>a</sup> תמות וז' בבהמה unblemished condition and male sex of sacrifices are required only of cattle. Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9
<sup>d</sup> צד ז' the male side of the hermaphrodite; מכח זַכְרוּתוֹ in as much as he is a male; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the thin and pointed side of a double tool</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 31
<sup>b</sup> ז' שלו the sharper side of a hatchet (used for splitting), opp. נקבות שלו the broader side. Cant. R. to I, 3 [read:] כאדם שמטביל זַכְרוּתוֹ של מכחול בים as much as one takes up when dipping the point of the painting staff into the paint bottle.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the fructifying principle, germ, bud, eye</italic> or 
<italic>strophiole</italic> (in plants); 
<italic>germinating spot</italic> (in eggs) &c., v. 
<xref rid="A00083">next w.</xref>—Y.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. VII, 9
<sup>d</sup> bot.; XII, 13
<sup>c</sup> bot. כדי ליטע זַכְרוּתָהּ של חיטה deep enough to plant the wheat grain up to its eye (so that it can take root). Y. Ter. X, end, 47
<sup>c</sup> ז' של חלמון that part of the yolk where germination sets in; ib. ז' של מוח the germinating point in the white of the egg (the more substantial and cohesive part).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the bony inside of an animal’s horn</italic> or 
<italic>hoofs, the bony projection over which the horny substance grows</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 27
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>b</sup> bot. Bekh. 44
<sup>a</sup> (Tosef. ib. II (I), 2 הזָכָר). [Zeb. 63
<sup>a</sup> בזכרות, v. זוּטְרָא I.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00472">
<head-word>זַכְרוּתא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>male genitals</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40
<sup>d</sup> bot. מן זכרותיה דדוהי; Y. Sabb. XIV, 14
<sup>d</sup> bot. מן יברותה דדידי or דדירי; Tosaf. to Ab. Zar. 27
<sup>b</sup> זכרות דחווי, read: מן זכרותא דדַחְוֵוי (v. דַּחֲוָא, דַּחְיָיא) a medicinal drink prepared of the phallus of Dionysian revellers; [oth. opin. v. infra].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. preced. 3) 
<italic>source, fountain-head, feeder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. 55
<sup>a</sup> ז' דירדנא וכ' the chief supply of the Jordan comes from the cave of Paneas. Ib. ז' דדמא וכ' the liver is the fountain-head of the blood. Ib. ז' דמיא וכ' (Yalk. Gen. 22 דברותא, read דַּכְרוּתָא or זַכְ') the Euphrates is the supplier of water (for the world), cmp. אֶוְותַּנְטִי.—[Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. מן ז' דדוהי from the source of menstruation, v. supra.] [Zeb. 63
<sup>a</sup>, v. זוּטְרָא I.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00473">
<head-word>זְכַרְיָה, </head-word>
<head-word>זְכַרְיָהוּ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<italic>Zechariah</italic>, 1) the prophet-priest slain in the Temple court (II Chr. XXIV, 20, sq.).</definition>
<notes>, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> the prophet-priest slain in the Temple court (II Chr. XXIV, 20, sq.). Targ. Lam. II, 20.—Gitt. 57
<sup>b</sup>; Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Lam. R. to II, 2; a. e.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>Zechariah</italic>, the prophet.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 21
<sup>a</sup>. Macc. 24
<sup>b</sup>. Snh. 99
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> Z. ben 
<italic>K’butal,</italic>
<pgbrk id="pg401" />a survivor of the Second Temple.</definition>
<notes> Yoma I, 6; ib. 19
<sup>b</sup> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 3, 4).—4) R. Z. son of Eucolus, a Tannai. Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 6, v. אֶבְקוֹלָס; Gitt. 56
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—5) R. Z., the butcher’s son, a Tannai. Eduy. VIII, 2. B. Bath. 111
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—6) name of several Amoraim. Y. Snh. I, 18
<sup>b</sup> top. Y. Pes. I, 27
<sup>b</sup> top; Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>d</sup> זבדיה; Num. R. s. 9 זכר'.—Snh. 67
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>; Y. Meg. IV, 75
<sup>c</sup> top הוה מעבר ז' removed one with a downy beard (from pronouncing the priestly benediction).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00487">
<head-word>זָלַח</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. זלג) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to drip, be wet</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Mets. VI, beg. 10
<sup>d</sup> שדהו זָלְחָה his field was too wet (for work).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sprinkle</italic> aromatic fluids. Num. R. s. 13, beg. מכבדות וזולחות וכ' (not וזוחלות) the winds sweep and sprinkle all the perfumes &c.; Yalk. Cant. 988 זולחת ומכבדת, read: מכ' וזוֹחֶלֶת; cmp. זְלוֹחָאָה.</definition>
<notes>—Tosef. Shek. I, 12 יִזְלַח לו זֶלַח וכ' (or יְזַלֵּחַ) one may use it for sprinkling before his bier (Y. ib. II, 47
<sup>a</sup> top יעשה לו זלוף).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זִילֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to sprinkle</italic> the floor for cooling or perfuming the air.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 3 אין מְזַלְּחִין את הבית וכ' (not החבית) one must not (on the Sabbath) sprinkle the house with any kind of sprinkling fluids.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="G00488">
<head-word>זְלַח</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>

<senses>

<definition>, 
<italic>to sprinkle, rain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXXVI, 28 (Ms. זחל). Targ. Cant. V, 13; a. e. [Targ. Is. XXX, 14, v. דְּלַח.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַזְלִיחַ, אַזְלַח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause a flux </italic>or
<italic> diarrhœa</italic> by fright.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XXIX, 9 (h. text יחולל).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִזְדְּלַח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be sprinkled, to gurgle forth</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="G00490">זִלְחָא</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXVIII, 4 מִיזְדְלַח מרזביא (Ms. מזדלף) gurgling (and forming) gutters (h. text גָּר).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>זֶלַח</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>

<notes> Tosef. Shek. I, 12, v. זָלַח.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְלָחִין</plural-form>. Sifra B’har, Par. 1, ch. I ולא לעשות … ז' but not for preparing perfumes, v. זִילּוּף. Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 3, v. זָלַח.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Ithpe.</italic></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00496">

<entry id="G00498">
<head-word>זָלַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pilp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זִלְזֵל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<entry id="G00535">
<head-word>זָמַן</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. זבן)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to arrange, designate</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זִימֵּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to invite</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to a meal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 79
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְזוּמָּן, f. מְזוּמֶּנֶת; pl. מְזוּמָּנִים, מְזוּמָּנוֹת a) 
<italic>invited</italic>. Pesik. R. s. 41, end מי שהוא מ' לסעודה he who is invited to the feast. Ib. (expl. מקראי, Is. XLVIII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> מְזוּמָּנִי My invited guest (Israel); a. e.—b) 
<italic>designated, chosen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 43
<sup>a</sup> הוא מ' לברכה he is the one designated (by the host) to say grace. Ab. Zar. 17
<sup>a</sup> מז' לחיי וכ' chosen for the bliss of futurity.—Snh. 102
<sup>a</sup> עת היא מ' וכ' there is a time designated for &c. Ib. יום מזומן (not עת היא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8); Yalk. Is. 330; ib. Jer. 287.—c) 
<italic>ready at hand, in one’s possession</italic>. B. Mets. 102
<sup>a</sup>; Sifré Deut. 227, a. e. כי יקרא פרט למ' ‘if it chance’ (Deut. XXII, 6) this excludes that which is at thy disposal (in thy court yard); a. e.—2) 
<italic>to appoint a meal in common</italic>, so as to say grace together; 
<italic>to preface the grace after meal by saying, Let us praise</italic> &c.; v. זִימּוּן. Ber. VII, 1 שלשה … חייבין לזַמֵּן if three dine together, they are bound to make an appointment for common grace. Ib. מְזַמְּנִין עליו common grace may be appointed by making him one of the party (offering him something to eat). Ib. אין מ' עליהן you cannot count them in (to make up the requisite number). Ib. 2 עד כמה מזמנין how much must one eat of the meal in order to be counted one of the company? Ib. 3 כיצד מ' how is the appeal for common grace made?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִזְמִין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to prepare, to notify.</italic></definition>
<notes> Dem. VII, 1 המַזְמִין את הבירו וכ' if one notifies his friend that he will dine with him (on the Sabbath).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to designate for use;</italic> v. 
<xref rid="E00302">הַזְמָנָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 26
<sup>a</sup> הִזְמִינוֹ וכ' if he designated a building for &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to summon</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="G00536">next w.</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִזְדַּמֵּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to meet, to come to hand</italic> (providentially); 
<italic>to join one’s self to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 96
<sup>a</sup> אותו מלאך שנ' לו וכ' that angel who was commissioned to accompany Abraham. Ib. נ' לו רגלי אחד a footman was joined to him (to meet his challenge). Ab. Zar. 25
<sup>b</sup> ישראל שנ' לו וכ' (Ḥull. 91
<sup>a</sup> שנטפל) an Israelite whom a gentile joins on the road. Shebi. VII, 4 שנִזְדַּמְּנוּ להם וכ' who accidentally caught unclean animals; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make an appointment for meeting one another</italic>.</definition>

<sense>

<italic>Pi.</italic>—Snh. 48
<sup>a</sup> דאַזְמְנֵיה וכ' which one designated for &c.—B. Bath. 58

<entry id="G00537">
<head-word>זְמָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>appointed time, term, time</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. I, 7, a. fr. הז' גרמא, v. גְּרָמָא.—B. Kam. 113
<sup>a</sup> קובעים ז' וכ' we appoint (in the summons to appear before court) a Monday, Thursday and Monday in succession. Gitt. 72
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. זְמַנּוֹ של שטר the date of the document.—Taan. 14
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. בז' הזה in our days (after the dissolution of the Jewish common-wealth). Ib. הכל לפי הז' all depends on the season (whether it is advanced or retarded, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400). Ib. זְמַנָּהּ של רביעה the rainy season; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְמַנִּים</plural-form>. Meg. 2
<sup>a</sup> ז' הרבה various dates (for reading the Megillah).—בִּזְמַן שֶׁ־ 
<italic>in the case of, when, if</italic>. Erub. VI, 7 אימתי בז' וכ' in what case (is this said)? When they carry &c. Ib. 6 ומודים בז' וכ' they all agree that, if some of them &c.; a. v. fr.—בִּזְמַנּוֹ, בִּזְמַנָהּ &c. 
<italic>in its prescribed</italic>, 
<italic>due time;</italic> חוּץ לִזְמַנּוֹ &c. 
<italic>out of time</italic>, 
<italic>beyond its due time</italic>. Zeb. I, 1. Ib. II, 3; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>festive season</italic> (cmp. מִקְרָא, מְאַרְעָא); 
<italic>‘Z’man’,</italic>
<italic>that section of the benediction on the entrance of a Festival which refers to the return of the festive season</italic> (שהחיינו והגיענו לזמן הזה …).</definition>
<notes> Pes. 102
<sup>b</sup> מדלא אמר ז' since he did not mention the benediction of 
<italic>Z’man</italic>, v. יקנה"ז. Succ. 48
<sup>a</sup> שמיני … ז' בפני עצמו the eighth day (of Succoth) … is a festive season for itself, requiring the insertion of 
<italic>Z’man;</italic> a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as above. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>c</sup> ג' ז' בבבל there are three festive seasons (idolatrous fairs) in Babylonia. Tosef. Ber. III, 13 חותם ברוך … והז' you must close with ‘Blessed be He … who sanctifies the Sabbath, Israel, and the Seasons.—[Snh. 101
<sup>a</sup> הקורא … שלא בזמנו he who cites a Biblical verse at a banquet out of its 
<italic>context</italic> (perverting its sense for lascivious purposes); Treat. Kallah beg.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> Gen. R. s. 33 ותִזְעַר נפשיה and he may get sick.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restrain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Sam. XVIII, 16 ed. Lag. a. Ar. (ed. מנע; h. text חשך).</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be small</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XII, 4; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

VI, 3. נכסים … זוֹקְקִין וכ' movable chattel binds the immovable with reference to the obligation of making oath, i.e. the two claims preferred in one suit are considered as one lawsuit, and the oath must refer to both; Y. Keth. XII, 36

<sense>
